notes: Vertical-slice layout: one overworld hub plus a linear chain of five dungeon rooms. overworld_01 -> dungeon_01 -> dungeon_02 -> dungeon_03 -> dungeon_04 -> dungeon_05. A room is open when its locked_by room has been cleared (clear flag set); locked_by null means open from the start. Per design, dungeon_03's clear flag is the boss-route gate and locks BOTH dungeon_04 and dungeon_05 — topology is still linear, so the player physically walks 04 before 05. exits.locked reflects the initial lock state at a fresh run.

rooms.notes: Safe-ish hub and tutorial space. Two wandering slimes teach attack and dodge; a heart pickup sits near the dungeon entrance. Exit leads down into the ruins (dungeon_01).
First dungeon room, slime-only so the player learns room-clear gates. Clearing this room unlocks the door to dungeon_02.
Introduces skeletons alongside slimes — the first dodge-check. Heart pickup rewards the clear. Clearing unlocks dungeon_03.

Midpoint pivot room. Its clear flag (dungeon_03_cleared) is the boss route gate: it unlocks BOTH dungeon_04 and dungeon_05. Also holds temple_key, which opens the boss arena door inside dungeon_05 — so the boss route needs the clear flag AND the key.

Hard fight before the boss — mixed skeleton/slime wave as the last combat check. Heart pickup as the pre-boss breather. Its exit into dungeon_05 is locked by the same dungeon_03 clear flag (boss route), not by dungeon_04's own clear.

Final boss room — holds the boss_guardian and the crown_fragment win item. The room itself is gated by dungeon_03's clear flag (boss route); the boss arena door additionally requires temple_key from dungeon_03. The crown_fragment only becomes collectable after boss death (condition boss_defeated), which triggers the Victory state per progression.json.
